title: Physics - Optics Question Bank (250 Questions, Bilingual English & Assamese)
subject: General Science - Physics (Optics)

questions.question_en: What is the speed of light in vacuum?
questions.answer_en: The speed of light in vacuum is 3 × 10^8 m/s.

questions.question_en: Who proposed the corpuscular theory of light?
questions.question_as: পোহৰৰ কণিকা তত্ত্ব কাক কৃতিত্ব দিয়া হয়?
questions.answer_en: Isaac Newton proposed the corpuscular theory of light.
questions.answer_as: আইজাক নিউটনে পোহৰৰ কণিকা তত্ত্ব আগবঢ়াইছিল।

questions.question_en: Who proposed the wave theory of light?
questions.answer_en: Christiaan Huygens proposed the wave theory of light.
questions.answer_as: খ্ৰীষ্টিয়ান হাইজেনছে পোহৰৰ তৰংগ তত্ত্ব আগবঢ়াইছিল।

questions.question_en: What is light?
questions.answer_en: Light is a form of electromagnetic radiation.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ হৈছে এক প্ৰকাৰৰ বিদ্যুৎ-চুম্বকীয় বিকিৰণ।

questions.question_en: What type of wave is light?
questions.answer_en: Light is a transverse electromagnetic wave.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ হৈছে এক অনুপ্ৰস্থ বিদ্যুৎ-চুম্বকীয় তৰংগ।

questions.question_en: What is the angle of incidence?
questions.answer_en: The angle between the incident ray and the normal.
questions.answer_as: আপতিত ৰশ্মি আৰু অভিলম্বৰ মাজৰ কোণ।

questions.question_en: State the first law of reflection.
questions.answer_en: The angle of incidence is equal to the angle of reflection.

questions.question_en: State the second law of reflection.
questions.answer_en: The incident ray, the reflected ray and the normal lie in the same plane.
questions.answer_as: আপতিত ৰশ্মি, প্ৰতিফলিত ৰশ্মি আৰু অভিলম্ব একে সমতলত থাকে।

questions.question_en: What is reflection of light?
questions.answer_en: The bouncing back of light from a surface.
questions.answer_as: পৃষ্ঠত পৰি পোহৰ ঘূৰি অহাকে পোহৰৰ প্ৰতিফলন বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is a ray of light?
questions.answer_en: A line representing the path of light.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰৰ গতি পথ দেখুওৱা ৰেখাক পোহৰৰ ৰশ্মি বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is a beam of light?
questions.answer_en: A collection of rays of light.
questions.answer_as: বহু পোহৰ ৰশ্মিৰ সমষ্টিক পোহৰৰ গুচ্ছ বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is the speed of light in water?
questions.answer_en: Approximately 2.25 × 10^8 m/s.

questions.question_en: What is the speed of light in glass?
questions.answer_en: Approximately 2 × 10^8 m/s.

questions.question_en: What is a plane mirror?
questions.answer_en: A flat mirror that reflects light.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ প্ৰতিফলিত কৰা সমান পৃষ্ঠৰ দাপোন।

questions.question_en: What type of image does a plane mirror form?
questions.question_as: সমতল দাপোনে কি ধৰণৰ প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A virtual, erect image of the same size.

questions.question_en: What is lateral inversion?
questions.answer_en: The left-right reversal of the image formed by a plane mirror.
questions.answer_as: সমতল দাপোনত প্ৰতিবিম্ব বাওঁ-সোঁ ওলোটা হৈ দেখা দিয়া।

questions.question_en: What is a real image?
questions.answer_en: An image formed by the actual meeting of light rays.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ ৰশ্মি প্ৰকৃততে মিলিত হোৱাত গঠন হোৱা প্ৰতিবিম্ব।

questions.question_en: What is a virtual image?
questions.answer_en: An image formed by the apparent meeting of light rays.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ ৰশ্মি আপাত দৃষ্টিত মিলিত হোৱাত গঠন হোৱা প্ৰতিবিম্ব।

questions.question_en: What is regular reflection?
questions.answer_en: Reflection from a smooth surface.

questions.question_en: What is diffuse reflection?
questions.answer_en: Reflection from a rough surface.

questions.question_en: What happens to light when it falls on a mirror?
questions.answer_en: It gets reflected.

questions.question_en: What is the unit of frequency of light?
questions.answer_en: Hertz.

questions.question_en: What is wavelength?
questions.answer_en: The distance between two successive crests of a wave.
questions.answer_as: তৰংগৰ দুটা ক্ৰমাগত শিখৰৰ মাজৰ দূৰত্ব।

questions.question_en: What is the relation between speed, frequency and wavelength of a wave?
questions.question_as: গতি, কম্পনাংক আৰু তৰংগদৈৰ্ঘ্যৰ মাজৰ সম্পৰ্ক কি?
questions.answer_en: v = f × λ.

questions.question_en: What is a luminous object?
questions.answer_en: An object that emits its own light.

questions.question_en: What is a non-luminous object?
questions.answer_en: An object that does not emit its own light.

questions.question_en: What is photometry?
questions.answer_en: The measurement of the intensity of light.

questions.question_en: What is the main source of light on Earth?
questions.answer_en: The Sun.

questions.question_en: What is a shadow?
questions.answer_en: A dark region formed when light is blocked by an object.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ বাধাপ্ৰাপ্ত হৈ গঠন হোৱা অন্ধকাৰ অঞ্চল।

questions.question_en: What causes an eclipse?
questions.answer_en: The blocking of sunlight by the Moon or the Earth.
questions.answer_as: চন্দ্ৰ বা পৃথিৱীয়ে সূৰ্য্যৰ পোহৰ বাধা দিয়াৰ বাবে গ্ৰহণ হয়।

questions.question_en: What is the dual nature of light?
questions.answer_en: Light behaves both as a wave and as a particle.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ তৰংগ আৰু কণা দুয়ো হিচাপে আচৰণ কৰে।

questions.question_en: What is a photon?
questions.answer_en: A quantum of light energy.

questions.question_en: What is the spectrum of white light?
questions.answer_en: VIBGYOR, the seven colours.

questions.question_en: What is the angle of reflection?
questions.answer_en: The angle between the reflected ray and the normal.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিফলিত ৰশ্মি আৰু অভিলম্বৰ মাজৰ কোণ।

questions.question_en: Who proposed the quantum theory of light?
questions.answer_en: Albert Einstein.

questions.question_en: What is a spherical mirror?
questions.answer_en: A mirror whose reflecting surface is part of a sphere.
questions.answer_as: যি দাপোনৰ প্ৰতিফলিত পৃষ্ঠ গোলকৰ অংশ, তাকে গোলাকাৰ দাপোন বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is a concave mirror?
questions.answer_en: A spherical mirror with the reflecting surface curved inwards.
questions.answer_as: যি দাপোনৰ প্ৰতিফলিত পৃষ্ঠ ভিতৰলৈ বেঁকা, তাকে অৱতল দাপোন বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is a convex mirror?
questions.answer_en: A spherical mirror with the reflecting surface curved outwards.
questions.answer_as: যি দাপোনৰ প্ৰতিফলিত পৃষ্ঠ বাহিৰলৈ বেঁকা, তাকে উত্তল দাপোন বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is the pole of a mirror?
questions.answer_en: The centre point of the reflecting surface.

questions.question_en: What is the principal axis?
questions.answer_en: The line joining the pole and the centre of curvature.
questions.answer_as: মেৰু আৰু বক্ৰতা কেন্দ্ৰ সংযোগী ৰেখা।

questions.question_en: What is the centre of curvature?
questions.answer_en: The centre of the sphere of which the mirror is a part.
questions.answer_as: যি গোলকৰ অংশ দাপোন, তাৰ কেন্দ্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What is the radius of curvature?
questions.answer_en: The distance between the pole and the centre of curvature.
questions.answer_as: মেৰু আৰু বক্ৰতা কেন্দ্ৰৰ মাজৰ দূৰত্ব।

questions.question_en: What is the focal length of a spherical mirror?
questions.answer_en: Half of the radius of curvature.

questions.question_en: What is the relation between focal length and radius of curvature?
questions.question_as: ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব আৰু বক্ৰতা ব্যাসাৰ্ধৰ মাজৰ সম্পৰ্ক কি?

questions.question_en: What is the focus of a mirror?
questions.answer_en: The point where rays parallel to the principal axis meet.
questions.answer_as: মূল অক্ষৰ সমান্তৰাল ৰশ্মি যি বিন্দুত মিলিত হয়, তাকে ফ'কাছ বোলে।

questions.question_en: Where is the image formed when the object is at infinity in a concave mirror?
questions.question_as: অৱতল দাপোনত বস্তু অসীমত থাকিলে প্ৰতিবিম্ব ক'ত গঠন হয়?
questions.answer_en: At the focus.

questions.question_en: What image does a concave mirror form when the object is between the pole and the focus?
questions.question_as: বস্তু মেৰু আৰু ফ'কাছৰ মাজত থাকিলে অৱতল দাপোনে কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A virtual, erect and magnified image.

questions.question_en: Which mirror is used in car headlights?
questions.question_as: গাড়ীৰ হেডলাইটত কোন দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: Concave mirror.

questions.question_en: Which mirror is used as a rear view mirror in vehicles?
questions.question_as: বাহনত ৰিয়েৰ ভিউ দাপোন হিচাপে কোন দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: Convex mirror.

questions.question_en: Which mirror is used as a shaving mirror?
questions.question_as: শ্বেৱিং দাপোন হিচাপে কোন দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: Concave mirror.

questions.question_en: Which mirror is used in a solar furnace?
questions.question_as: সৌৰ চুলাত কোন দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: Concave mirror.

questions.question_en: What is the magnification of a mirror?
questions.answer_en: The ratio of the image height to the object height.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ উচ্চতা আৰু বস্তুৰ উচ্চতাৰ অনুপাত।

questions.question_en: What is the mirror formula?
Which sign convention is used in solving mirror problems?
questions.question_as: দাপোনৰ সমস্যা সমাধানত কোন চিহ্ন ৰীতি ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: The Cartesian sign convention.

questions.question_en: What is the focal length of a plane mirror?
questions.answer_en: Infinity.

questions.question_en: Which type of mirror has a virtual focus?
questions.answer_en: Convex mirror.

questions.question_en: Which type of mirror has a real focus?
questions.answer_en: Concave mirror.

questions.question_en: What image does a convex mirror always form?
questions.question_as: উত্তল দাপোনে সদায় কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A virtual, erect and diminished image.

questions.question_en: What is the nature of the image when the object is beyond the centre of curvature of a concave mirror?
questions.question_as: অৱতল দাপোনত বস্তু বক্ৰতা কেন্দ্ৰৰ বহু দূৰত থাকিলে প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ প্ৰকৃতি কি?
questions.answer_en: Real, inverted and diminished.

questions.question_en: Where is the image formed when the object is at the centre of curvature of a concave mirror?
questions.question_as: বস্তু বক্ৰতা কেন্দ্ৰত থাকিলে প্ৰতিবিম্ব ক'ত গঠন হয়?
questions.answer_en: At the centre of curvature, real, inverted and of the same size.
questions.answer_as: বক্ৰতা কেন্দ্ৰত, সৎ, ওলোটা আৰু একে আকাৰৰ।

questions.question_en: What is the sign of magnification for a real inverted image?
questions.question_as: সৎ ওলোটা প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ বিবৰ্ধনৰ চিহ্ন কি?
questions.answer_en: Negative.

questions.question_en: What is the sign of magnification for a virtual erect image?
questions.question_as: অসৎ সৰল প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ বিবৰ্ধনৰ চিহ্ন কি?
questions.answer_en: Positive.

questions.question_en: Which mirror is used by dentists to examine teeth?
questions.question_as: দন্ত চিকিৎসকে দাঁত পৰীক্ষা কৰিবলৈ কোন দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ কৰে?
questions.answer_en: Concave mirror.

questions.question_en: Why is a concave mirror used in a solar cooker?
questions.question_as: সৌৰ চুলাত অৱতল দাপোন কিয় ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: To concentrate sunlight at the focus.

questions.question_en: What is the nature of the image when the object is between C and F in a concave mirror?
questions.question_as: অৱতল দাপোনত বস্তু C আৰু F ৰ মাজত থাকিলে প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ প্ৰকৃতি কি?
questions.answer_en: Real, inverted and magnified, formed beyond C.
questions.answer_as: সৎ, ওলোটা আৰু বিবৰ্ধিত, C ৰ বাহিৰত গঠন হয়।

questions.question_en: What is refraction of light?
questions.answer_en: The bending of light when it passes from one medium to another.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰ এটা মাধ্যমৰ পৰা আনটো মাধ্যমলৈ যাওঁতে বেঁকা হোৱাকে প্ৰতিসৰণ বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is the cause of refraction?
questions.answer_en: The change in the speed of light in different media.
questions.answer_as: বিভিন্ন মাধ্যমত পোহৰৰ গতি সলনি হোৱা।

questions.question_en: State Snell's law.
questions.answer_en: n1 sin i = n2 sin r.
questions.answer_as: n1 sin i = n2 sin r।

questions.question_en: What is refractive index?
questions.answer_en: The ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to its speed in a medium.
questions.answer_as: শূন্যত পোহৰৰ গতি আৰু মাধ্যমত পোহৰৰ গতিৰ অনুপাত।

questions.question_en: What is absolute refractive index?
questions.answer_en: The refractive index measured with respect to vacuum.

questions.question_en: What is the refractive index of water?
What is the refractive index of glass?
questions.answer_en: About 1.5.

questions.question_en: What is the refractive index of diamond?
How does light bend when it travels from a rarer to a denser medium?
questions.question_as: পোহৰ লঘু মাধ্যমৰ পৰা ঘন মাধ্যমলৈ গলে কেনেকৈ বেঁকা হয়?
questions.answer_en: It bends towards the normal.

questions.question_en: How does light bend when it travels from a denser to a rarer medium?
questions.question_as: পোহৰ ঘন মাধ্যমৰ পৰা লঘু মাধ্যমলৈ গলে কেনেকৈ বেঁকা হয়?
questions.answer_en: It bends away from the normal.

questions.question_en: What is the critical angle?
questions.answer_en: The angle of incidence for which the angle of refraction is 90 degrees.
questions.answer_as: যি আপতন কোণত প্ৰতিসৰণ কোণ 90 ডিগ্রী হয়, তাকে সংকট কোণ বোলে।

questions.question_en: What is total internal reflection?
questions.answer_en: The complete reflection of light inside a denser medium.
questions.answer_as: ঘন মাধ্যমৰ ভিতৰতে পোহৰ সম্পূৰ্ণৰূপে প্ৰতিফলিত হোৱা।

questions.question_en: What is the critical angle of glass?
questions.answer_en: About 42 degrees.

questions.question_en: What is the critical angle of water?
questions.answer_en: About 49 degrees.

questions.question_en: Why does a diamond sparkle?
questions.answer_en: Due to total internal reflection of light inside it.
questions.answer_as: ইয়াৰ ভিতৰত পোহৰৰ সম্পূৰ্ণ আভ্যন্তৰীণ প্ৰতিফলন হোৱাৰ বাবে।

questions.question_en: What is an optical fibre based on?
questions.question_as: অপটিকেল ফাইবাৰ কিসৰ ওপৰত ভিত্তি কৰি গঠিত?
questions.answer_en: Total internal reflection of light.

questions.question_en: What is apparent depth?
questions.answer_en: The depth of an object as seen due to refraction.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিসৰণৰ বাবে দেখা যোৱা বস্তুৰ গভীৰতা।

questions.question_en: What is real depth?
questions.answer_en: The actual depth of an object.

questions.question_en: What is the relation between refractive index and depth?
questions.question_as: প্ৰতিসৰণাংক আৰু গভীৰতাৰ মাজৰ সম্পৰ্ক কি?
questions.answer_en: n = real depth / apparent depth.

questions.question_en: Why does a pencil immersed in water appear bent?
questions.question_as: পানীত ডুবাই ৰখা পেঞ্চিল কিয় বেঁকা দেখা যায়?
questions.answer_en: Due to refraction of light.

questions.question_en: What is a mirage caused by?
questions.answer_en: Total internal reflection of light.

questions.question_en: What is the refractive index of air?
questions.answer_en: Approximately 1.

questions.question_en: How is the speed of light in a medium calculated?
questions.question_as: মাধ্যমত পোহৰৰ গতি কেনেকৈ নিৰ্ণয় হয়?
questions.answer_en: By dividing c by the refractive index, v = c/n.

questions.question_en: What is lateral shift?
questions.answer_en: The perpendicular distance between the incident and the emergent rays.
questions.answer_as: আপতিত আৰু নিৰ্গত ৰশ্মিৰ মাজৰ লম্ব দূৰত্ব।

questions.question_en: What does a rectangular glass slab demonstrate?
questions.question_as: আয়তাকাৰ কাঁচৰ ফলকে কি প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: Refraction and lateral shift of light.

questions.question_en: When does refraction of light not occur?
questions.answer_en: When light falls normally on the surface.

questions.question_en: Why do stars twinkle?
questions.answer_en: Due to atmospheric refraction.

questions.question_en: Why does the Sun appear reddish at sunrise and sunset?
questions.question_as: সূৰ্যোদয় আৰু সূৰ্যাস্তত সূৰ্য্য কিয় ৰঙা দেখায়?
questions.answer_en: Due to the scattering of light.

questions.question_en: What is optical density?
questions.answer_en: The property of a medium to refract light.

questions.question_en: Which is optically denser, water or glass?
questions.question_as: পানী আৰু কাঁচৰ ভিতৰত কোনটো আলোকীয়ভাৱে ঘন?
questions.answer_en: Glass.

questions.question_en: What is the relation between refractive index and the speed of light?
questions.question_as: প্ৰতিসৰণাংক আৰু পোহৰৰ গতিৰ মাজৰ সম্পৰ্ক কি?
questions.answer_en: n = c/v.

questions.question_en: What happens to the wavelength of light when it enters a denser medium?
questions.question_as: ঘন মাধ্যমত সোমালে পোহৰৰ তৰংগদৈৰ্ঘ্যৰ কি হয়?
questions.answer_en: It decreases.

questions.question_en: Why does a fish in water appear shallower than it really is?
questions.question_as: পানীত থকা মাছ কিয় বাস্তৱ গভীৰতাতকৈ কম গভীৰতাত দেখা যায়?
questions.answer_en: Due to refraction making the image appear shallower.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিসৰণৰ বাবে প্ৰতিবিম্ব ওপৰলৈ উঠি দেখা যায়।

questions.question_en: What happens to the frequency of light when it enters a denser medium?
questions.question_as: ঘন মাধ্যমত সোমালে পোহৰৰ কম্পনাংকৰ কি হয়?
questions.answer_en: It remains unchanged.

questions.question_en: What is the refractive index of a medium in which the speed of light is 2 × 10^8 m/s?
questions.question_as: যি মাধ্যমত পোহৰৰ গতি 2 × 10^8 মিটাৰ/ছেকেণ্ড, তাৰ প্ৰতিসৰণাংক কিমান?

questions.question_en: What is a convex lens?
questions.answer_en: A lens that is thicker at the centre than at the edges.
questions.answer_as: কেন্দ্ৰত ডাঠ আৰু কাষত চেকা লেন্স।

questions.question_en: What is a concave lens?
questions.answer_en: A lens that is thinner at the centre than at the edges.
questions.answer_as: কেন্দ্ৰত চেকা আৰু কাষত ডাঠ লেন্স।

questions.question_en: What is the focal length of a lens?
questions.answer_en: The distance between the optical centre and the focus.
questions.answer_as: আলোক কেন্দ্ৰ আৰু ফ'কাছৰ মাজৰ দূৰত্ব।

questions.question_en: What is the optical centre of a lens?
questions.answer_en: The centre point of a lens through which light passes undeviated.
questions.answer_as: লেন্সৰ মাজবিন্দু, যাৰ মাজেৰে পোহৰ বিচ্যুত নোহোৱাকৈ যায়।

questions.question_en: What is the power of a lens?
questions.answer_en: The reciprocal of its focal length expressed in metres.
questions.answer_as: মিটাৰত প্ৰকাশিত ফ'কাছ দূৰত্বৰ বিপৰীত ৰাশি।

questions.question_en: What is the unit of power of a lens?
questions.answer_en: Dioptre.

questions.question_en: What is the lens formula?
What is the magnification of a lens?
questions.answer_en: The ratio of the image distance to the object distance, v/u.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিবিম্ব দূৰত্ব আৰু বস্তু দূৰত্বৰ অনুপাত, v/u।

questions.question_en: What image does a convex lens form when the object is at infinity?
questions.question_as: বস্তু অসীমত থাকিলে উত্তল লেন্সে কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A real and inverted image at the focus.

questions.question_en: What is the sign of the power of a convex lens?
questions.answer_en: Positive.

questions.question_en: What is the sign of the power of a concave lens?
questions.answer_en: Negative.

questions.question_en: What is a converging lens?
questions.answer_en: A convex lens.

questions.question_en: What is a diverging lens?
questions.answer_en: A concave lens.

questions.question_en: When does a convex lens act as a magnifying glass?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্স কেতিয়া মেগনিফাইং গ্লাছ হিচাপে কাম কৰে?
questions.answer_en: When the object is placed within its focal length.

questions.question_en: What image does a concave lens always form?
questions.question_as: অৱতল লেন্সে সদায় কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A virtual, erect and diminished image.

questions.question_en: What is one dioptre?
questions.answer_en: The power of a lens having a focal length of one metre.
questions.answer_as: এটা মিটাৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্বৰ লেন্সৰ ক্ষমতা।

questions.question_en: What is the focal length of a lens of power 2 dioptre?
questions.question_as: 2 ডায়'প্টাৰ ক্ষমতাৰ লেন্সৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব কিমান?
questions.answer_en: 0.5 metre.

questions.question_en: What is the power of a lens having a focal length of 50 cm?
questions.question_as: 50 চে.মি. ফ'কাছ দূৰত্বৰ লেন্সৰ ক্ষমতা কিমান?
questions.answer_en: 2 dioptre.

questions.question_en: What is the centre of curvature of a lens?
questions.answer_en: The centre of the sphere of which the lens surface is a part.
questions.answer_as: যি গোলকৰ অংশ লেন্সৰ পৃষ্ঠ, তাৰ কেন্দ্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What is the principal focus of a convex lens?
questions.answer_en: The point where rays parallel to the principal axis converge.
questions.answer_as: মূল অক্ষৰ সমান্তৰাল ৰশ্মি যি বিন্দুত মিলিত হয়।

questions.question_en: What is the principal focus of a concave lens?
questions.answer_en: The point from which rays parallel to the principal axis appear to diverge.
questions.answer_as: যি বিন্দুৰ পৰা মূল অক্ষৰ সমান্তৰাল ৰশ্মিবোৰ অপসাৰিত হোৱা যেন লাগে।

questions.question_en: Which lens has a shorter focal length, a thick lens or a thin lens?
questions.question_as: ডাঠ লেন্স আৰু চেকা লেন্সৰ ভিতৰত কোনটোৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব কম?
questions.answer_en: The thick lens.

questions.question_en: What image is formed when the object is at 2F of a convex lens?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্সত বস্তু 2F ত থাকিলে কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন হয়?
questions.answer_en: A real, inverted image of the same size at 2F.
questions.answer_as: 2F ত সৎ, ওলোটা আৰু একে আকাৰৰ প্ৰতিবিম্ব।

questions.question_en: What image is formed when the object is between F and 2F of a convex lens?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্সত বস্তু F আৰু 2F ৰ মাজত থাকিলে কি প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন হয়?
questions.answer_en: A real, inverted and magnified image beyond 2F.
questions.answer_as: 2F ৰ বাহিৰত সৎ, ওলোটা আৰু বিবৰ্ধিত প্ৰতিবিম্ব।

questions.question_en: When does a convex lens form a virtual image?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্সে কেতিয়া অসৎ প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: When the object is placed between the optical centre and the focus.
questions.answer_as: বস্তু আলোক কেন্দ্ৰ আৰু ফ'কাছৰ মাজত ৰাখিলে।

questions.question_en: What is a biconvex lens?
questions.answer_en: A lens curved outwards on both surfaces.

questions.question_en: What is a plano-convex lens?
questions.answer_en: A lens with one plane and one convex surface.
questions.answer_as: এটা সমতল আৰু এটা উত্তল পৃষ্ঠৰ লেন্স।

questions.question_en: What is the power of a combination of lenses?
questions.answer_en: The sum of the powers of the individual lenses.

questions.question_en: What is the combined focal length of two thin lenses in contact?
questions.question_as: সংস্পৰ্শত থকা দুটা চেকা লেন্সৰ সম্মিলিত ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব কি?

questions.question_en: What is the unit of focal length?
questions.answer_en: Metre.

questions.question_en: What is a meniscus lens?
questions.answer_en: A lens with one convex and one concave surface.
questions.answer_as: এটা উত্তল আৰু এটা অৱতল পৃষ্ঠৰ লেন্স।

questions.question_en: Where is the image formed when the object is at the focus of a convex lens?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্সত বস্তু ফ'কাছত থাকিলে প্ৰতিবিম্ব ক'ত গঠন হয়?
questions.answer_en: At infinity.

questions.question_en: Which lens is used in a camera?
questions.answer_en: A convex lens.

questions.question_en: What is the function of a lens?
questions.answer_en: To converge or diverge light.

questions.question_en: What happens to the image when the object moves from 2F towards F in a convex lens?
questions.question_as: উত্তল লেন্সত বস্তু 2F ৰ পৰা F লৈ যাওঁতে প্ৰতিবিম্বৰ কি হয়?
questions.answer_en: The image moves away from the lens and becomes larger.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰতিবিম্ব লেন্সৰ পৰা আঁতৰি যায় আৰু ডাঙৰ হয়।

questions.question_en: What is a prism?
questions.answer_en: A transparent block having a triangular cross-section.
questions.answer_as: ত্ৰিভুজাকাৰ ছেদ অংশ থকা স্বচ্ছ টুকুৰা।

questions.question_en: What is the angle of a prism?
questions.answer_en: The angle between its two refracting surfaces.
questions.answer_as: ইয়াৰ দুটা প্ৰতিসৰণ পৃষ্ঠৰ মাজৰ কোণ।

questions.question_en: What is the angle of minimum deviation?
questions.answer_en: The smallest angle of deviation produced by a prism.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰিজমত হোৱা আটাইতকৈ কম বিচ্যুতি কোণ।

questions.question_en: What is the prism formula?
questions.answer_en: n = sin((A + Dm)/2) / sin(A/2).

questions.question_en: What is dispersion of light?
questions.answer_en: The splitting of white light into its constituent colours.
questions.answer_as: বগা পোহৰ বহু ৰঙত বিভক্ত হোৱা।

questions.question_en: Who first studied the dispersion of light through a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমৰ মাজেৰে পোহৰৰ বিক্ষেপণ পোনপ্ৰথমে কোনে অধ্যয়ন কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Isaac Newton.

questions.question_en: What is a spectrum?
questions.answer_en: The band of colours formed by the dispersion of light.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰৰ বিক্ষেপণত গঠন হোৱা ৰঙৰ পটি।

questions.question_en: What is the order of colours in the visible spectrum?
questions.answer_en: Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red.
questions.answer_as: বেঙুনীয়া, নীল-বেঙুনীয়া, নীলা, সেউজীয়া, হালধীয়া, কমলা, ৰঙা।

questions.question_en: Which colour deviates the most in a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমত কোন ৰং আটাইতকৈ বেছি বিচ্যুতি হয়?
questions.answer_en: Violet.

questions.question_en: Which colour deviates the least in a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমত কোন ৰং আটাইতকৈ কম বিচ্যুতি হয়?
questions.answer_en: Red.

questions.question_en: Why does violet light deviate the most in a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমত বেঙুনীয়া পোহৰ কিয় আটাইতকৈ বেছি বিচ্যুতি হয়?
questions.answer_en: Because it has the smallest wavelength and the highest refractive index.
questions.answer_as: কাৰণ ইয়াৰ তৰংগদৈৰ্ঘ্য আটাইতকৈ কম আৰু প্ৰতিসৰণাংক আটাইতকৈ বেছি।

questions.question_en: What is a rainbow?
questions.answer_en: A spectrum formed by the dispersion of sunlight in raindrops.
questions.answer_as: বৰষুণৰ টোপালত সূৰ্য্যৰ পোহৰ বিক্ষেপণ হৈ গঠন হোৱা বৰ্ণালী।

questions.question_en: What causes a rainbow to form?
questions.answer_en: Refraction, dispersion and total internal reflection in raindrops.
questions.answer_as: বৰষুণৰ টোপালত প্ৰতিসৰণ, বিক্ষেপণ আৰু সম্পূৰ্ণ আভ্যন্তৰীণ প্ৰতিফলন।

questions.question_en: What is the angle of deviation in a prism?
questions.answer_en: The angle between the incident ray and the emergent ray.
questions.answer_as: আপতিত ৰশ্মি আৰু নিৰ্গত ৰশ্মিৰ মাজৰ কোণ।

questions.question_en: How does the angle of deviation vary with the angle of incidence in a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমত বিচ্যুতি কোণ আপতন কোণৰ লগত কেনেকৈ সলনি হয়?
questions.answer_en: It first decreases, reaches a minimum, and then increases.
questions.answer_as: প্ৰথমে কমে, ন্যূনতমত উপনীত হয়, তাৰ পিছত বাঢ়ে।

questions.question_en: What is angular dispersion?
questions.answer_en: The difference between the angles of deviation of violet and red light.
questions.answer_as: বেঙুনীয়া আৰু ৰঙা পোহৰৰ বিচ্যুতি কোণৰ পাৰ্থক্য।

questions.question_en: What is dispersive power?
questions.answer_en: The ratio of angular dispersion to the mean deviation.
questions.answer_as: কৌণিক বিক্ষেপণ আৰু মধ্যমীয়া বিচ্যুতিৰ অনুপাত।

questions.question_en: What is recombination of light?
questions.answer_en: Combining the colours of the spectrum to obtain white light.
questions.answer_as: বৰ্ণালীৰ ৰঙবোৰ লগ লগাই বগা পোহৰ পোৱা।

questions.question_en: How can white light be recombined after dispersion?
questions.question_as: বিক্ষেপণৰ পিছত বগা পোহৰ কেনেকৈ পুনঃসংযুক্তি হয়?
questions.answer_en: By placing a second inverted prism in the path.
questions.answer_as: পথত দ্বিতীয় এখন ওলোটা প্ৰিজম ৰাখিলে।

questions.question_en: What is an achromatic prism?
questions.answer_en: A combination of prisms that cancels dispersion.

questions.question_en: Why does light bend while passing through a prism?
questions.question_as: প্ৰিজমৰ মাজেৰে যাওঁতে পোহৰ কিয় বেঁকা হয়?
questions.answer_en: Due to refraction at its two surfaces.
questions.answer_as: ইয়াৰ দুটা পৃষ্ঠত প্ৰতিসৰণ হোৱাৰ বাবে।

questions.question_en: What is the emergent ray?
questions.answer_en: The ray that leaves the prism.

questions.question_en: What is the incident ray on a prism?
questions.answer_en: The ray that enters the prism.

questions.question_en: How is the path of light through a prism in the minimum deviation position?
questions.question_as: ন্যূনতম বিচ্যুতি অৱস্থাত প্ৰিজমৰ মাজেৰে পোহৰৰ পথ কেনেকুৱা?
questions.answer_en: Symmetric, parallel to the base.

questions.question_en: What are the seven colours of the spectrum collectively called?
questions.question_as: বৰ্ণালীৰ সাতটা ৰঙক একেলগে কি বোলে?
questions.answer_en: VIBGYOR.

questions.question_en: What is a microscope used for?
questions.answer_en: To see very small objects.

questions.question_en: What is a compound microscope?
questions.answer_en: A microscope using two convex lenses.
questions.answer_as: দুটা উত্তল লেন্স ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা অণুবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What are the two lenses of a compound microscope?
questions.question_as: যৌগিক অণুবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰৰ দুটা লেন্স কি?
questions.answer_en: Objective and eyepiece.

questions.question_en: What is a telescope used for?
questions.answer_en: To see distant objects clearly.

questions.question_en: What is an astronomical telescope?
questions.answer_en: A telescope using two convex lenses to view celestial bodies.
questions.answer_as: দুটা উত্তল লেন্সেৰে জ্যোতিষ্ক দৰ্শন কৰা যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What is the magnification of a telescope?
questions.answer_en: The ratio of the focal length of the objective to that of the eyepiece.
questions.answer_as: অব্জেক্টিভ আৰু আইপিছৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্বৰ অনুপাত।

questions.question_en: What is a camera?
questions.answer_en: An instrument that records images on a sensor or film.

questions.question_en: What type of lens is used in a camera?
questions.question_as: কেমেৰাত কি ধৰণৰ লেন্স ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: A convex lens.

questions.question_en: What is the aperture of a camera?
questions.answer_en: The opening that controls the amount of light entering the camera.
questions.answer_as: কিমান পোহৰ সোমাব সেই নিয়ন্ত্ৰণ কৰা খোলা।

questions.question_en: What is a periscope?
questions.answer_en: An instrument used to see over obstacles.
questions.answer_as: বাধা আঁৰৰ পৰা চাবলৈ ব্যৱহৃত যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What principle does a periscope work on?
questions.answer_en: Reflection from plane mirrors.

questions.question_en: How many mirrors does a periscope have?
questions.answer_en: Two.

questions.question_en: What is a simple microscope?
questions.answer_en: A single convex lens used as a magnifying glass.
questions.answer_as: মেগনিফাইং গ্লাছ হিচাপে ব্যৱহৃত এটা উত্তল লেন্স।

questions.question_en: What is a projector?
questions.answer_en: A device that projects magnified images on a screen.
questions.answer_as: পৰ্দাত বিবৰ্ধিত ছবি প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰা যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What is the eyepiece of an optical instrument?
questions.answer_en: The lens near the eye.

questions.question_en: What is the objective of an optical instrument?
questions.answer_en: The lens near the object.

questions.question_en: What is a reflecting telescope?
questions.answer_en: A telescope that uses a concave mirror as the objective.
questions.answer_as: অব্জেক্টিভ হিচাপে অৱতল দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা দূৰবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: Who built the first astronomical telescope?
questions.question_as: পোনপ্ৰথম জ্যোতিষ্ক দূৰবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰ কোনে নিৰ্মাণ কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Galileo Galilei.

questions.question_en: What is a spectroscope?
questions.answer_en: An instrument used to study the spectrum.

questions.question_en: What is a binocular?
questions.answer_en: An instrument with two telescopes, one for each eye.
questions.answer_as: দুখন দূৰবীক্ষণ থকা, প্ৰতিটো চকুৰ বাবে এখন।

questions.question_en: What is a kaleidoscope?
questions.answer_en: An instrument using mirrors to produce patterns.
questions.answer_as: দাপোন ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি চিত্ৰ গঠন কৰা যন্ত্ৰ।

questions.question_en: What does a solar cooker use to concentrate sunlight?
questions.question_as: সৌৰ চুলাই সূৰ্য্যৰ পোহৰ কেন্দ্ৰীভূত কৰিবলৈ কি ব্যৱহাৰ কৰে?
questions.answer_en: A concave mirror.

questions.question_en: What is an ophthalmoscope?
questions.answer_en: An instrument used to examine the inside of the eye.

questions.question_en: What is the function of the objective lens of a telescope?
questions.question_as: দূৰবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰৰ অব্জেক্টিভ লেন্সৰ কাম কি?
questions.answer_en: To form a real image of the distant object.
questions.answer_as: দূৰৰ বস্তুৰ সৎ প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰা।

questions.question_en: What is the function of the eyepiece of a telescope?
questions.question_as: দূৰবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰৰ আইপিছ লেন্সৰ কাম কি?
questions.answer_en: To magnify the image formed by the objective.
questions.answer_as: অব্জেক্টিভে গঠন কৰা প্ৰতিবিম্ব বিবৰ্ধন কৰা।

questions.question_en: What is a magnifying glass?
questions.answer_en: A convex lens used to see small objects enlarged.
questions.answer_as: সৰু বস্তু ডাঙৰকৈ চাবলৈ ব্যৱহৃত উত্তল লেন্স।

questions.question_en: What instrument measures the refractive index of a substance?
questions.answer_en: A refractometer.

questions.question_en: What is an endoscope based on?
questions.question_as: এন্ডোস্কোপ কিসৰ ওপৰত ভিত্তি কৰি গঠিত?
questions.answer_en: Optical fibres and total internal reflection.
questions.answer_as: অপটিকেল ফাইবাৰ আৰু সম্পূৰ্ণ আভ্যন্তৰীণ প্ৰতিফলন।

questions.question_en: What kind of image does a camera form?
questions.question_as: কেমেৰাই কি ধৰণৰ প্ৰতিবিম্ব গঠন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: Real and inverted.

questions.question_en: Which instrument is used in a submarine to see the surface?
questions.question_as: ডুব জাহাজৰ পৰা পানীৰ ওপৰ চাবলৈ কোন যন্ত্ৰ ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?
questions.answer_en: Periscope.

questions.question_en: What is the function of the eye lens?
questions.answer_en: To focus light on the retina.

questions.question_en: Which part of the eye controls the amount of light entering?
questions.question_as: চকুত কিমান পোহৰ সোমাব সেই নিয়ন্ত্ৰণ কোন অংশে কৰে?
questions.answer_en: The pupil.

questions.question_en: What is the iris?
questions.answer_en: The coloured part of the eye that controls the size of the pupil.
questions.answer_as: চকুৰ ৰঙীন অংশ, যিয়ে পিউপিলৰ আকাৰ নিয়ন্ত্ৰণ কৰে।

questions.question_en: Where is the image formed in the eye?
questions.answer_en: On the retina.

questions.question_en: What is the retina?
questions.answer_en: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.

questions.question_en: What is the least distance of distinct vision?
questions.answer_en: 25 cm.

questions.question_en: What is the near point of a normal eye?
questions.answer_en: At 25 cm.

questions.question_en: What is myopia?
questions.answer_en: Nearsightedness, the inability to see distant objects clearly.
questions.answer_as: দূৰৰ বস্তু স্পষ্টকৈ নেদেখা চকুৰ ৰোগ।

questions.question_en: Which lens corrects myopia?
questions.answer_en: Concave lens.

questions.question_en: What is hypermetropia?
questions.answer_en: Farsightedness, the inability to see near objects clearly.
questions.answer_as: ওচৰৰ বস্তু স্পষ্টকৈ নেদেখা চকুৰ ৰোগ।

questions.question_en: Which lens corrects hypermetropia?
questions.answer_en: Convex lens.

questions.question_en: What is presbyopia?
questions.answer_en: The age-related loss of accommodation of the eye.
questions.answer_as: বয়সৰ লগত চকুৰ সমায়োজন ক্ষমতা হ্ৰাস হোৱা।

questions.question_en: Which lens corrects presbyopia?
questions.answer_en: Bifocal lens.

questions.question_en: What is accommodation of the eye?
questions.answer_en: The ability of the eye to change the focal length of its lens.
questions.answer_as: চকুৱে নিজৰ লেন্সৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব সলনি কৰিব পৰা ক্ষমতা।

questions.question_en: What is the power of accommodation?
questions.answer_en: The maximum change possible in the focal length of the eye lens.
questions.answer_as: চকুৰ লেন্সৰ ফ'কাছ দূৰত্ব সলনি হোৱা অধিকতম পৰিমাণ।

questions.question_en: What is the far point of a myopic eye?
questions.answer_en: At a finite distance, less than infinity.

questions.question_en: What is the near point of a hypermetropic eye?
questions.answer_en: Farther than 25 cm.

questions.question_en: What is astigmatism?
questions.answer_en: Blurred vision caused by the irregular curvature of the cornea.
questions.answer_as: কৰ্ণিয়াৰ অসম বক্ৰতাৰ বাবে হোৱা অস্পষ্ট দৃষ্টি।

questions.question_en: What is the function of the cornea?
questions.answer_en: To refract light entering the eye.

questions.question_en: What is the blind spot?
questions.answer_en: The point on the retina with no photoreceptor cells.
questions.answer_as: ৰেটিনাৰ যি বিন্দুত কোনো আলোক-সংবেদী কোষ নাথাকে।

questions.question_en: What is interference of light?
questions.answer_en: The superposition of two coherent light waves.

questions.question_en: Who first demonstrated interference of light?
questions.question_as: পোহৰৰ ব্যতিচাৰ পোনপ্ৰথমে কোনে প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Thomas Young.

questions.question_en: What does Young's double-slit experiment show?
questions.question_as: ইয়ংৰ দ্বি-চেলি পৰীক্ষাই কি প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰে?
questions.answer_en: The wave nature of light.

questions.question_en: What is constructive interference?
questions.answer_en: Superposition of waves that produces a bright fringe.
questions.answer_as: যি অধিস্থাপনত উজ্জ্বল দাগ গঠন হয়।

questions.question_en: What is destructive interference?
questions.answer_en: Superposition of waves that produces a dark fringe.
questions.answer_as: যি অধিস্থাপনত অন্ধকাৰ দাগ গঠন হয়।

questions.question_en: What is the condition for constructive interference?
questions.answer_en: Path difference = nλ.

questions.question_en: What is the condition for destructive interference?
questions.answer_en: Path difference = (2n + 1)λ/2.

questions.question_en: What is a fringe?
questions.answer_en: A bright or dark band in an interference pattern.
questions.answer_as: ব্যতিচাৰ ছবিত উজ্জ্বল বা অন্ধকাৰ পটি।

questions.question_en: What is fringe width?
questions.answer_en: The distance between two successive bright fringes.
questions.answer_as: দুটা ক্ৰমাগত উজ্জ্বল দাগৰ মাজৰ দূৰত্ব।

questions.question_en: What is the formula for fringe width?
questions.answer_en: β = λD/d.

questions.question_en: What are coherent sources?
questions.answer_en: Sources that emit waves with a constant phase difference.
questions.answer_as: যি উৎসৰ তৰংগৰ মাজত স্থিৰ দশা পাৰ্থক্য থাকে।

questions.question_en: Why is interference not observed with two ordinary lamps?
questions.question_as: দুটা সাধাৰণ বাল্বৰ পৰা ব্যতিচাৰ কিয় দেখা নাযায়?
questions.answer_en: Because the sources are not coherent.

questions.question_en: What are Newton's rings?
questions.answer_en: Circular interference fringes obtained with a plano-convex lens on a glass plate.
questions.answer_as: কাঁচ ফলকত প্লেনো-কনভেক্স লেন্স ৰাখিলে পোৱা বৃত্তাকাৰ ব্যতিচাৰ দাগ।

questions.question_en: Why do soap bubbles show colours?
questions.question_as: সাবানৰ বুদবুদত কিয় ৰং দেখা যায়?
questions.answer_en: Due to interference of light in the thin film.

questions.question_en: What is thin-film interference?
questions.answer_en: Interference of light in thin films such as oil or soap films.
questions.answer_as: তেল বা সাবানৰ পাতল আৱৰণত পোহৰৰ ব্যতিচাৰ।

questions.question_en: What is diffraction of light?
questions.answer_en: The bending and spreading of light waves around obstacles.
questions.answer_as: বাধাৰ কাষেদি পোহৰ তৰংগ বেঁকা হৈ বিয়পি পৰা।

questions.question_en: What is the condition for noticeable diffraction?
questions.answer_en: The size of the obstacle should be comparable to the wavelength.
questions.answer_as: বাধাৰ আকাৰ তৰংগদৈৰ্ঘ্যৰ সমান পৰিমাণৰ হোৱা উচিত।

questions.question_en: What is the single-slit diffraction pattern?
questions.answer_en: A bright central maximum with fainter maxima on both sides.
questions.answer_as: উজ্জ্বল কেন্দ্ৰীয় মাক্সিমা আৰু দুয়োফালে ক্ষীণ মাক্সিমা।

questions.question_en: Why is diffraction of sound easy to observe?
questions.question_as: শব্দৰ বিবৰ্তন কিয় সহজে দেখা যায়?
questions.answer_en: Because sound has a much larger wavelength.

questions.question_en: Why is diffraction of light hard to observe?
questions.question_as: পোহৰৰ বিবৰ্তন কিয় সহজে দেখা নাযায়?
questions.answer_en: Because light has a very small wavelength.

questions.question_en: What is resolving power?
questions.answer_en: The ability of an optical instrument to distinguish two close objects.
questions.answer_as: ওচৰা-ওচৰি দুটা বস্তু পৃথক কৰা আলোকীয় যন্ত্ৰৰ ক্ষমতা।

questions.question_en: What limits the resolving power of a microscope?
questions.question_as: অণুবীক্ষণ যন্ত্ৰৰ বিচ্ছেদন ক্ষমতা কিসে সীমিত কৰে?
questions.answer_en: The wavelength of light.

questions.question_en: What is polarization of light?
questions.answer_en: The restriction of light vibrations to a single plane.
questions.answer_as: পোহৰৰ কম্পন একে সমতলত সীমাবদ্ধ হোৱা।

questions.question_en: Which type of waves can be polarized?
questions.question_as: কোন ধৰণৰ তৰংগ মেৰুকৃত হ'ব পাৰে?
questions.answer_en: Transverse waves.

questions.question_en: Can sound waves be polarized?
questions.answer_en: No, because they are longitudinal waves.

questions.question_en: What is a polaroid?
questions.answer_en: A material that polarizes light.

questions.question_en: What is plane-polarized light?
questions.answer_en: Light in which the vibrations occur in a single plane.
questions.answer_as: যি পোহৰৰ কম্পন একে সমতলত হয়।

questions.question_en: What is Brewster's angle?
questions.answer_en: The angle of incidence at which reflected light is fully polarized.
questions.answer_as: যি আপতন কোণত প্ৰতিফলিত পোহৰ সম্পূৰ্ণ মেৰুকৃত হয়।

questions.question_en: State Brewster's law.
questions.answer_en: tan θp = n.

questions.question_en: What is a Nicol prism used for?
questions.answer_en: To produce plane-polarized light.

questions.question_en: Why are polaroids used in sunglasses?
questions.answer_en: To reduce glare from reflected light.

questions.question_en: What are the bright and dark regions in an interference pattern called?
questions.question_as: ব্যতিচাৰ ছবিত উজ্জ্বল আৰু অন্ধকাৰ অঞ্চলক কি বোলে?
questions.answer_en: Bright and dark fringes.

questions.question_en: What is the central fringe in double-slit interference?
questions.answer_en: Bright.

questions.question_en: How does the fringe width change when the screen is moved farther away?
questions.question_as: পৰ্দা আঁতৰালে দাগৰ প্ৰস্থৰ কি হয়?
questions.answer_en: It increases.

questions.question_en: How does the fringe width change when the slit separation is increased?
questions.question_as: চেলিৰ মাজৰ দূৰত্ব বাঢ়িলে দাগৰ প্ৰস্থৰ কি হয়?
questions.answer_en: It decreases.

questions.question_en: Who discovered polarization of light by reflection?
questions.question_as: প্ৰতিফলনৰ দ্বাৰা পোহৰৰ মেৰুকৰণ কোনে আৱিষ্কাৰ কৰিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Étienne-Louis Malus.

questions.question_en: What is the difference between interference and diffraction fringes?
questions.question_as: ব্যতিচাৰ আৰু বিবৰ্তন দাগৰ মাজৰ পাৰ্থক্য কি?
questions.answer_en: Interference fringes are equally spaced while diffraction fringes are not.
questions.answer_as: ব্যতিচাৰ দাগ সমান দূৰত্বত থাকে, কিন্তু বিবৰ্তন দাগ সমান দূৰত্বত নাথাকে।

questions.question_en: What do interference and diffraction prove about light?
questions.question_as: ব্যতিচাৰ আৰু বিবৰ্তনে পোহৰৰ বিষয়ে কি প্ৰমাণ কৰে?
questions.answer_en: The wave nature of light.

questions.question_en: What is the width of the central maximum in single-slit diffraction?
questions.question_as: এক-চেলি বিবৰ্তনত কেন্দ্ৰীয় মাক্সিমাৰ প্ৰস্থ কিমান?
questions.answer_en: Twice the width of the other maxima, 2λD/a.

questions.question_en: What is the use of polarization in LCD screens?
questions.answer_en: To control the transmission of light.
